description: Varies one attribute of the notes passing through an MPX stream, leaving everything else as it arrived

params.text: Chooses which attribute is varied: duration, level, pan, timing or detune
Chooses the character of the variation: white, a random walk, or Perlin noise
Sets how far the attribute is moved, 0 to 100%, and at nought the notes come out exactly as they went in
Sets how fast the variation moves, 0.05 to 8 cycles per beat, and it means nothing for white
Chooses whether the variation repeats the same way each time round or is different on every pass

inputs.text: Takes the note stream to vary

outputs.text: Carries the varied notes on as an MPX stream

notes: mpx IN takes a note stream from the mpx OUT of another DreamerMPX module, and the module does nothing until one is patched there
mpx OUT carries a note stream, not a voltage; patch it to another DreamerMPX module's mpx IN, or to fromMPX where ordinary voltages are wanted
up to four MPX cables can be patched into the one MPX input, and the notes arriving on them are merged
a cable between two MPX jacks turns pink once it has taken; a cable from an MPX jack to anything else keeps its ordinary colour and carries nothing
nothing comes out until an MPX output is patched to the input
an MPX cable carries a note stream rather than a voltage and goes to an MPX input; fromMPX turns a stream back into gates and pitch for the wider rack
